name: rig-os-site
description: MCP surface definition for the RIG OS public website. This file documents the intended tools, resources, and prompts for future MCP server implementation.
implementation_note: No MCP server is running. This manifest is a design artifact only. Real-time MCP server implementation requires a sealed DoneContract.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List all HTML pages in the site.
tools.output: Array of page paths relative to repo root.

tools.name: get_page_content
tools.description: Retrieve the raw HTML content of a specific page.

input_schema.page: string - relative path to the HTML file (e.g. 'index.html', 'about.html')

tools.name: check_site_health
tools.description: Run the deterministic smoke check and return pass/fail results.

resources.description: All public HTML pages in the site.

auth.notes: All content is public. No secrets, tokens, or credentials needed for read operations.

deferred: Prompt templates deferred pending V10 content audit.
Live MCP server deferred pending sealed DoneContract.
Authentication model deferred (site is fully public).
Write/deploy tools intentionally excluded; require human approval.
boundaries: No secrets, tokens, or private data may be exposed through any MCP tool.
No deploy, publish, or schedule actions are permitted without human approval.
No tool may read or write outside the repo working directory without explicit permission.
